Sepia.


Symptoms.

Generalities.

Stiffness  of  thejoints  (hands,  knees
and  feet.)

Arthritic  pains  (in  the  joints)....

Tearing  in  the  muscles

Sensation  of  contraction   in

the  outer  parts

Cramp  pain  in  the  muscles

Excessive  sensitiveness  of  the

body  to  pain

Sore  pain  in  the  outer  parts

in  the  inner  parts

Burning  pain  in  many  parts  of  the

body  (especially  in  the  inner  parts).
Bleeding'  from  the  inner  parts

Congestions  at  night,  with  palpita-
tions of  the  heart,  and  pulsation  all
over.

Jerking  and  twitching  of  the

limbs  during  the  day.

Twitching  in  the  muscles

Inflammatory  swellings

Stinging  pain  in  the  limbs

in  the  bones

in  the  inner  parts

Tingling  in  the  outer  parts

from  bed

•Mind  and  Disposition.

Sadness,  with  weeping


Discouragement

SEPIA.


Symptoms.

Mind  and  Disposition.

Restlessness ;  fidgety

Great  indifference


even  to  his  own  family

Is  easily  offended

Inclines  to  be  vehement...

Dread  of  being  alone

Sadness  about  her  health

domestic  affairs

Aversion  to  his  occupation.
Heavy  flow  of  ideas


Weak  memory.


Sensorium.

Stupefaction  in  the  head  (which
disables  him  from  performing  any
mental  labour).

Vertigo,  when  walking  in  the  open
air.

when  rising  from  the  bed


or  in  the  afternoon

Head.
Paroxysms  of  Haemicrania...

with  boring

and  sticking,  extorting  cries.

with  nausea


and  vomiting.


Head -ache   every    morning,  with

nausea.
when  shaking  or  moving  the  head.

when  stepping,  as  from  commotion

of  the  brain.
with  stinging,  often  one-sided

or    in    the    forehead    (with

nausea).
relieved  by  lying  down

Head.

Head-ache,  shooting  above  the  left
eje.

as  if  the  eyes  would  fall  out

as  if  the  head  would  burst

External  coldness  of  the  head

Itching-  on  the  head

in  the  nose  and  on  the  eyes

Falling  off  of  the  hair


Small  red  pimples  on  the  fore-
head.
Rough  forehead


Eyes,

Pressure  on  the  eyeballs .


Inflammation   of  the  eyes  with

redness.
■ and  stinging  pain


Burning  of  the  eyes,  in  the  morning.

Eachrymation  in  the  morning...

and  evening

Fungus  haematodes

UJightly   agglutination    of  the

eyes.

The  eyelids  pain  in  the  morning
when  awaking,  as  if  they  were  too
heavy,  and  as  if  he  could  not  keep
them  open

Inability  to  open  the  eyelids  at
night

Heaviness  and  falling  down
of  the  upper  eyelids.

Eyelids  inflamed

Eyes.
Eyelids  red


swollen ,


Styes  (Hordeola).

the  ear

and  inflamed

Ulcerated  nostrils...
Stoppage  of  the  nose....,


Dry  Coryza

ryza
